c74object.name: evi_flanger_digital
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A basic two-stage Flanger effect with saturation
c74object.description:
evi_flanger_digital is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_flanger_digital.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_counting.genexpr, evi_smooth.genexpr, evi_lfo.genexpr
evi_flanger_digital is also available in MSP as: evi.flanger.digital~.
A basic flanger example created from classic comb filter blocks. Triangle/sine LFO types can be morphed and skewed. Multiple controls for manipulation of audio mix.

geninlet.name: left
geninlet.digest: Audio In. Left or mono audio input depending on the @stereo attribute.

geninlet.name: right
geninlet.digest: Audio In. Right audio input if @stereo attribute is on.

geninlet.name: reset
geninlet.digest: Naive. Reset of internal LFO phases is naive and not anti-aliased.

attribute.name: cross
attribute.description: Crosses over 0..1 the wet left and wet right audio streams between the first and second stages of the flanger. Can add an interesting shift in the stereo image.

attribute.name: depth
attribute.description: The relative size of the modulation delay. At 0 the flanger delay is 0 ms, at 1, the chorus delay modulates between its extremes, set by @mintime and @maxtime arguments in ms.

attribute.name: drywet
attribute.description: The global dry/wet mix of the flanger. 0 is completely dry, 1 is completely wet.

attribute.name: duty
attribute.description: One of four LFO controls (@duty, @shape, @skew, @zeroreset). @duty changes the duty cycle of the LFO triangle shape.

attribute.name: feedback
attribute.description: The global feedback gain. The feedback path is safely saturated and anti-aliased.

attribute.name: feedforward
attribute.description: Linear feedforward gain mapped across two delay stages.

attribute.name: gain
attribute.description: Attenuation or boost applied between the two saturation stages.

attribute.name: inject
attribute.description: @inject is mapped to the direct gain coefficients of the embedded comb filter delays.

attribute.name: invert
attribute.description: Inverts the polarity of the flanged audio before mixing to the output. Switching invert is smoothed.

attribute.name: maxhz
attribute.description: The maximum in Hz that the @rate attribute can reach. Typically these values are kept small for a flanger.

attribute.name: maxtime
attribute.description: The maximum delay time for the flanger. Whether or not this value is reached depends on the @depth attribute.

attribute.name: mintime
attribute.description: The minimum delay time for the chorus. Whether or not this value is reached depends on the @depth attribute. For a flanger this is typically at or near 0.

attribute.name: rate
attribute.description: The global speed of the LFO phases. This sets the speed (between 0..@maxhz) the LFOs scale the delay times (set by @depth, @mintime and @maxtime).

attribute.name: shape
attribute.description: One of four LFO controls (@duty, @shape, @skew, @zeroreset). @shape smoothly morphs the LFO shape between triangle (0) and sine (1).

attribute.name: skew
attribute.description: One of four LFO controls (@duty, @shape, @skew, @zeroreset). @skew exponentially shapes the LFO output.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time of the internal parameters.

attribute.name: spread
attribute.description: The left/right spread of the audio outputs, actually the phase offset of the two internal LFOs. 0..1 is exponentially mapped to 0..180 degrees shift.

attribute.name: stereo
attribute.description: If off, the audio input to the process is taken only from the Left inlet 1 as mono. If @stereo is on, the audio inputs are taken from both left (1) and right (2) inlets. The audio output is always stereo.

attribute.name: zeroreset
attribute.description: One of four LFO controls (@duty, @shape, @skew, @zeroreset). If on, changes to the speed (@rate) of the internal LFOs are synchronised to zero reset of phase, which can produce seemless updating of speed changes. Otherwise the speed (@rate) updates smoothly morphing changes.
